sources.title: SceneFun3D
sources.snippet: We introduce SceneFun3D, a large-scale dataset with highly accurate interaction annotations in 3D real-world indoor environments. Abstract Existing 3D scene understanding methods are heavily focused on 3D semantic and instance segmentation.
